Clash erupts during Mayor's visit to Jalandhar temple

A clash occurred between two groups during a 'shukrana yatra' (gratitude visit) by Mayor Vinit Dheer at the Devi Talab Mandir in Jalandhar. The altercation escalated from arguments to stone-pelting, causing a stampede. Police have initiated an investigation, with three teams examining CCTV footage to identify the accused.
